blueprints.description: An official forecast you understand, a contribution record checked year by year with gaps fixed or knowingly left, a claiming age chosen on paper, and the payments, credits and survivor rights kept right once the pension starts.

blueprints.description: Every tax-free and tax-deferred wrapper you hold listed, this year's limits and deadlines known, a written funding order, and the routines that use each allowance fully and correctly.

blueprints.description: A staged plan for raising heirs who can handle money: shared family values, age-by-age lessons, regular family meetings, supervised first responsibility and honest conversations about what they will inherit.
